question: Heerat starts from point A and walks 2 km towards east. She then takes a left turn and walks 2 km. She takes another left turn and walks 2 km. She takes a final left turn and walks 5 km to reach a point B. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she walk in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Heerat starts from point A and walks 2 km towards east.

She then takes a left turn and walks 2 km.

She takes another left turn and walks 2 km.

She takes a final left turn and walks 5 km to reach a point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40c9acca49254fdce68e9e395ad314fe012ca53a1cc071a2c332825247b0e578.png] 

So, She should drive 3 km to North in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
